name: Spicy Egg Fried Rice with Carrots, Peas, Green Beans & Corn (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup jasmine rice
1 ½ cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
½ lb green beans

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the green onions, along with soy sauce, vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar. Stir to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the carrots, along with corn and peas.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup frozen corn
1 cup frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
neutral vegetable oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat another skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place eggs, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are set, then remove from heat.
Transfer 1 cup of the veggies and a ⅔-cup of the scrambled eggs to a plate for the kids. Add remaining eggs to the skillet with the veggies.
When the rice is done, add 2/3-cup to the plate with the veggies and eggs. Add remaining rice to the skillet, along with the stir-fry sauce, and stir to combine.
Return skillet to medium-high heat and cook, stirring frequently, until warmed through and coated in sauce, 1-2 minutes. Remove fried rice from heat.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide reserved veggies, eggs, and rice between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide fried rice between plates and enjoy!
